race.comment: TOO TOUGH (2) resumes. Things haven't gone to plan the past couple but he's better than that and while a heavy track winner, a firmer track here off a reset should suit with the main danger coming out. VOLATILE (3) is racing consistently without winning, off a short break into last start here when third. Can strip fitter and figure. SUB GAUGE (1) has been below his best the past couple, okay last time on heavy at Moe. He gets a lovely map just trailing the pace with the 3kg claimer and should run an honest race. SONIC SURGE (4) was much better last time at Ballarat Synthetic having struggled on the heavy prior. Finds a nice race on top of the ground.
